title: Followers of Horus secret societies preserving knowledge from the First Time

tellings.quote: that these were secret societies which were entrusted with preserving information from what they call the first time and passing it down to future generations.

plain: In ancient Egypt, groups known as the Followers of Horus were secret societies charged with keeping knowledge from what the Egyptians called the 'First Time', a lost early age, and passing it on to later generations. The writer Graham Hancock, who writes about lost ancient civilisations, sets out this idea, citing his co-author Robert Bauval and their book Talisman. If true, it would mean ancient wisdom was handed down in secret over thousands of years.
